'''2001 Georgia State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Georgia in 2001. [[Charlie Herren]] won it.<ref name="dt-15907">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15907 Oh You Didn't know], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 12 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15907/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15907/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 12 May)
* '''Site:''' Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Charlie Herren]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

| 1st || [[Charlie Herren]]<ref name="dt-15907" /> || [[2001 Georgia State Championship Charlie Herren Oh You Didn't know|Agents Of Black Sun]] || —
|}

Herren won with the Dark Agents Of Black Sun deck he had played since two weeks after Reflections II came out. At States it ran Kuat where the posted list has Wakeelmui or Kuat, and the version he played up to States had three Emperors.<ref name="dt-15907" />
